'''Rathe Palror''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tunroth]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served as a member of [[Churhee's Riflemen]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He also was a crew member of the ''[[Hopskip]]'' that was sent on a [[Capture of Zekka Thyne|mission]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. He was a twelfth-class [[Tunroth Hunter]], also known as ''[[shturlan]]''.
